rationale: This compounds directly on the current winner instead of resetting: the zero-init gated final-block recurrence worked despite lower step count, so the next serious test is the minimal two-block extension suggested by the recurrent-depth lessons. The script now replays the last two decoder blocks once more with shared weights and per-channel zero-init gates, preserving the baseline at initialization, keeping shapes compile-stable, and adding only tiny float-kept control tensors while leaving the quant-aware endgame and exact int8+zlib evaluation path untouched. The hypothesis is that one extra shared late-tail refinement buys more final roundtrip quality per byte than another endgame-only quantizer tweak, while staying much closer to the proven recurrence path than the earlier failed carryover transplant.
title: Zero-Init Two-Block Tail Recurrence
